reason: The registered AIM configuration did not complete a development fit within either infrastructure allowance. No pilot artifact was produced and the sealed 10000-record reserve remained unopened. The replacement is a fully specified pure-DP categorical generator that is computationally feasible and supports the same conditional post-processing reliability claim.

mechanism_changes.name: DP class-conditional categorical sampler, epsilon=20
mechanism_changes.privacy_claim: One pure epsilon-DP fit of a class-conditional categorical model followed by repeated post-processing samples; reliability is conditional on this fitted private generator.

unchanged: pilot-derived cutoff rule and direct slacks
privacy_accounting: The released noisy vector contains the class histogram and one feature-by-class contingency table for each of 17 categorical features. One record changes one cell in each of 18 tables, giving L1 sensitivity 18. Independent Laplace noise with scale 18/epsilon is added to every count. Clipping, smoothing, and all release draws are post-processing.
